ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; the visible ventral surface consists of approximately 98% low-intensity black pixels with minimal high-intensity white pixel interruptions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly solid black across both lobes. Small, high-contrast white pixel clusters are isolated to the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow, acute-angled V-shaped depression at the central lobe junction with a sharp pixel-depth transition.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge boundary, featuring irregular pixel-level peaks and valleys across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the outer lateral margins tapering to sharp points at the tips; trailing edges are predominantly straight with jagged micro-topography.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct localized clusters of high-intensity white pixels at the terminal ends of the fluke; a single small circular white spot is visible on the upper mid-section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of three parallel diagonal linear disruptions of slightly higher intensity grayscale than the base black pigment on the left lobe's upper region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Ragged, irregular edge loss and clustered high-contrast scarring at the lateral tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly uniform black pigmentation across the entire fluke surface with an absence of large-scale mottling or focal pigmentation patches.
